firmware.name: TouchDegenerator
firmware.author: Joep Vermaat
firmware.description: A layered stereo looper for the Synthux Simple Touch 2 that lets you irreversibly degrade recorded material, inspired by Basinski's Disintegration Loops.

firmware.name: Terrarium
firmware.author: ymillion
firmware.description: Terrarium turns the Synthux Touch 2 into a self-evolving sound ecosystem. Each pad plants a sound organism.

firmware.name: TouchCreek
firmware.author: Petr Vlk
firmware.description: A sample-free procedural creek synthesizer for the Synthux Simple Touch: from a trickle to a lively stream, playable in tune from the pads or via MIDI.

firmware.name: TouchPlaited
firmware.author: Jon Waterschoot
firmware.description: A Synthux Simple Touch firmware based on Mutable Instruments Plaits (Émilie Gillet, MIT License): a 7-voice touch synth plus a 16-step generative drum sequencer, playable at the same time.

firmware.name: TouchPulsar
firmware.author: Petr Vlk
firmware.description: A pulsar synthesizer for the Synthux Simple Touch, after Curtis Roads: formant pulse trains, masking, convolution and live input, played from the pads or via MIDI.

firmware.name: TouchSpore
firmware.author: Jon Waterschoot
firmware.description: Generative plinks and pads for the Synthux Simple Touch. Pad touches, hand distance and the noise from plants or wires drive the notes.

firmware.name: TouchVink
firmware.author: Jon Waterschoot
firmware.description: A Jaap Vink style feedback instrument for the Synthux Simple Touch: a self-regulating delay, ring-mod and reverb loop that keeps itself moving, played from the pads.

firmware.name: TribalTouch
firmware.author: ymillion
firmware.description: TribalTouch turns the Synthux Touch 2 into a seven-voice generative percussion instrument.
